description: Listing check and heuristic listing probability (0 to 1) for an entity on Binance, Coinbase or Upbit. An asset that already trades there (CoinGecko tickers) answers listed true with no probability. Otherwise a BCA editorial heuristic over coverage, narrative strength, risk, audit and team signals, with the components shown; not a forecast. Unseeded when the indicator inputs are missing; partial when the entity has no CoinGecko id or some inputs are unknown. Pro tier.

exchange.description: Exchange to check: binance (default), coinbase or upbit.

name: predict_listing
